ClusterRuleResourceId.description_en: The resource ID of the cluster rule

RuleConfig.description_en:
The configuration of the traffic routing rule.

check_mode: Defines the traffic scope for the routing rule. Valid values:

all: Routes all traffic.

part: Routes a portion of the traffic.

type: The rule's match type. Valid values:

exact: Exact match.

regex: Regular expression match.

substance: The value of the rule
RuleConfig.description_zh:
引流规则配置：

check_mode 模式选择 取值：
all：全量引流
part：指定部分引流
type：规则匹配类型取值：
exact：精准
regex：正则
substance：规则值

RuleStatus.description_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
RuleStatus.description_zh:
规则状态，取值范围如下：

off：关闭
